clips.title: The story
paras: Maggot Eye's Paw is the gruesome trophy taken from the gnoll chieftain Maggot Eye at Garren's Haunt. Carried back to Brill, it serves as physical proof of the beast's execution for grave-robbing on behalf of the Scourge.

Maggot Eye earned the harsh wrath of the Forsaken by raiding graves and pillaging the countryside near Garren's Haunt, providing corpses to bolster the ranks of the Lich King's armies. In response, a formal death sentence and bounty were posted in the town of Brill. Because mere rumors of a death are never enough for military administrators like Executor Zygand, bounty hunters must sever the villain's paw and bring it back to town to collect their reward and close the bounty.
